alerts.name: Strict-Transport-Security Header Not Set
alerts.description: Responses are served over HTTP without an HSTS policy.
alerts.solution: Serve the API via HTTPS and send a Strict-Transport-Security header.

alerts.name: X-Frame-Options Header Not Set
alerts.description: Pages that can be framed are potentially vulnerable to clickjacking.
alerts.solution: Return an X-Frame-Options: DENY or Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors directive.

alerts.name: X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing
alerts.description: The API responses do not set an X-Content-Type-Options header.
alerts.solution: Send X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff for all responses.

alerts.name: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
alerts.description: Responses do not define a Content-Security-Policy header.
alerts.solution: Add a CSP header tuned for the FastAPI frontend responses.

alerts.name: Incomplete or No Cache-control Header
alerts.description: Some responses are missing Cache-control headers.
alerts.solution: Set Cache-Control: no-store for sensitive endpoints.

notes: Alert counts reflect the latest baseline run on GitHub Actions.
